hero.headline: Give every property conversation a
hero.description: The Funders Network is a no-cost, property-first engagement workspace for approved Realtor partners. Create reports and campaigns from an MLS number, connect existing buyers or leads, share through approved workflows, follow useful engagement signals, access branded marketing support, and use Open House QR tools when they fit.
hero.note: Programme access, rewards, and fulfilment are subject to approval, availability, and applicable brokerage/compliance requirements.

preview.title: My Property Campaign
preview.subtitle: Buyer engagement workspace
preview.update_detail: High-level file updates keep the Realtor aligned while buyer financial detail stays private.

overview.label: One property-first system
overview.headline: Useful for the buyer.
overview.description: Turn a property into an educational report, a permissioned buyer signal, reusable marketing support, and a more organized path for follow-up.

features.title: Property report delivery
features.description: Create an educational property-financing report from an MLS number and share a clearer next step with a buyer.

features.title: Direct buyer and lead follow-up
features.description: Add the appropriate buyer, open a prepared email, or reuse a generic report link through your approved email or CRM workflow.

features.title: Buyer engagement workspace
features.description: Track property campaigns, report activity, buyer milestones, and high-level Funders updates from one workspace.

features.title: Branded marketing support
features.description: Use your saved profile to support social graphics, a property brochure, and editable follow-up messages.

features.title: Compare homes
features.description: Use the same illustrative financing assumptions to compare homes with a buyer who is narrowing a shortlist.

features.title: Optional Open House QR campaigns
features.description: Add QR registration, campaign timing, and live engagement tracking when an Open House is part of the plan.

workflow.label: The shared workflow
workflow.headline: From a property to a
workflow.description: The Realtor stays central to the property conversation. The Funders Team handles the confidential financing workflow when the buyer is ready.

steps.title: Create from the property
steps.description: Enter the MLS number, review the property details, and create the report or campaign.

steps.title: Connect the buyer
steps.description: Add an existing buyer or lead, or use an optional QR campaign to capture permissioned interest.

steps.title: Share and follow
steps.description: Send the report through your approved workflow and act on useful engagement milestones.

steps.title: Keep moving
steps.description: Continue the property relationship while The Funders Team supports private financing next steps.

privacy.visible_description: Useful engagement and high-level file progress that helps the Realtor serve the buyer better.
visible_items: Property-report activity and permissioned campaign engagement
Buyer milestones and high-level Funders updates
privacy.private_description: The Funders Network is designed so Realtors can stay helpful without receiving confidential mortgage-file information.
private_items: Buyer phone, income, debt, credit, bank statements, and tax documents
Down-payment evidence, documents, and lender or underwriting notes
Actual funded amount or internal reward value
Unsupported approval, pre-approval, qualification, or lender-commitment claims

rewards.headline: Build more buyer value.
rewards.description: Eligible property campaigns can show estimated potential points. After verified funding, points are submitted for Administrator review and become visible only after approval.
rewards.note: Points are not cash. Rewards, travel, tickets, availability, eligibility, and fulfilment remain subject to programme terms and Administrator approval.

tiers.description: Travel and milestone packages, subject to terms
